question: Aceitera Peninsular Española company founded year founding location and headquarters address
markdown:
Aceitera Peninsular Española S.L.
was founded in July 1993 (with family olive oil tradition spanning five generations). It is headquartered and located in Priego de Córdoba, Spain, with an address at Calle Rihuelo s/n, 14800 Priego de Córdoba, Córdoba, Spain.
